newsitem.title: USA: IBM Credit Q1 net higher.
newsitem.headline: IBM Credit Q1 net higher.

text.p: International Business Machines Corp said Wednesday its unit IBM Credit Corp reported a net profit of $79.2 million for the first quarter, compared to $73.9 million for the same period last year.
Capital equipment financing originated for end users in the quarter increased seven percent to $1.3 billion, compared with $1.2 billion a year ago, it said.
Working capital financing originated for distribution channels in the quarter rose 23 percent to $3.1 billion, compared to $2.6 billion for the same period in 1996, it said.
IBM said the wholly-owned subsidiary had assets totaling $12.8 billion for the quarter, compared with $12.9 billion at the end of last year.
The subsidiary offers businesses end-user customer leasing and financing for IBM and complementary products.
